title: Prepare and visualize data with Microsoft Power BI
Design effective reports in Power BI
notes: Teaches data visualization specifically using Power BI.

title: Introduction to Cloud Infrastructure: Describe cloud concepts
Introduction to Git
notes: Foundational coverage of software configuration through version control, tracking changes, and branching. Does not cover all configuration management practices.

title: An introduction to software development
notes: Foundational coverage of software modelling, object-oriented concepts and development processes. Not a comprehensive software architecture course.

title: Get started with unit testing
notes: Practical unit-testing tutorial using Visual Studio and primarily C# examples. Covers a subset of software testing; duration not published.

title: AI Fluency
notes: Covers foundational AI, generative AI, responsible usage and critical evaluation.

title: Extending and developing your thinking skills
notes: General analytical and structured thinking course, applicable across occupations.

title: Making creativity and innovation happen
notes: General creativity and innovation course. Not specific to software engineering.

title: Develop Code Features Using GitHub Copilot Tools
notes: Practical AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot. Teaches generating, reviewing, modifying and rejecting AI code suggestions. Exercises require Copilot access; the Free plan is sufficient according to the provider.

title: Develop Unit Tests Using GitHub Copilot Tools
notes: Generate, run and improve unit tests using AI assistance. Exercises focus on C# in VS Code. GitHub Copilot Free is sufficient for the exercises.

title: Responsible AI with GitHub Copilot
notes: 15-minute module on responsible AI use, limitations, ethical risks and accountability when using AI-generated code.

title: Introduction to bookkeeping and accounting
notes: Introductory double-entry bookkeeping, trial balances and financial statements. General accounting education; not specific to Malaysian reporting rules.

title: Financial statement analysis and interpretation
notes: Financial ratio analysis and interpreting statements; does not fully teach preparation of financial reports.

title: Assertions and audit evidence
notes: Free audit study notes on assertions, accuracy, completeness and evidence. Partial coverage of attention to detail; no provider-published duration.

title: Professional Ethics
notes: Free accountancy and audit ethics study notes, including integrity, objectivity and independence. No provider-published duration.

title: Capital Investment Appraisal
notes: Free investment-appraisal notes on cash flows, net present value, internal rate of return and payback. Relevant to financial cost-benefit reasoning, but not a complete general cost-benefit analysis course; no provider-published duration.

title: Work smarter with Copilot prompts for finance professionals
notes: 28-minute beginner module on AI-supported finance analysis, models and reports. AI adaptation rather than financial analysis fundamentals; using Microsoft 365 Copilot features may require a paid licence.

title: Get started with finance agents
notes: 83-minute intermediate module on finance AI agents, invoice workflows, anomaly detection and reconciliation. Partial link to financial reporting, not a general attention-to-detail course. Prior accounts-receivable knowledge is expected; hands-on software may require licences.
